title: Clinical decision support for vestibular diagnosis: large-scale machine learning with lived experience coaching.
summary: A machine-learning vestibular diagnostic model was tested on 670 unseen instances; exact predictions were correct in 60.9%, with partial matches reported separately.
organization: Seoul National University Hospital; College of Medicine; Chungnam National University

evidence.tested: The machine-learning vestibular model was evaluated on 670 unseen instances; exact predicted diagnoses matched in 60.9%, with partial matches reported separately.
evidence.unknown: The held-out diagnostic accuracy does not establish prospective effects on vestibular-care decisions or patient outcomes.
evidence.ai_role: Uses a machine-learning vestibular diagnostic model to predict diagnoses on 670 unseen instances; exact matches were 60.9%, with partial matches reported separately.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
